Container.Name: romm-tools
Container.Overview: RomM companion tools in one container with one web page. Save sync: keeps emulator saves and save states in a Syncthing folder in sync with RomM, both ways, with a dashboard (RomM covers, state screenshots), approvals, conflict resolution and a recycle bin. ROM folders: builds a folder of links per emulation frontend (Batocera, RetroBat, Knulli...) into your ROM folders, and maps your folders to RomM platforms (volume lines for RomM's compose file + config.yml). Either part can be used alone. Save sync is based on romm_syncthing_sync by amn-96 (MIT).
Container.Requires: Save sync: a running RomM instance (4.5+, 5.x recommended) and a folder of saves/states, e.g. synced by Syncthing. ROM folders: your ROM folders on a share (no RomM connection needed).

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Web page port

Config.Name: Saves folder
Config.Description: Saves (.srm, .sav…), one subfolder per system. Use 'ro' only if PULL_MODE=off.

Config.Name: States folder
Config.Description: Save states (.state*, .state*.png), one subfolder per system.

Config.Name: App data
Config.Description: Save sync history, pending approvals, backups, and the ROM folders mapping and settings. Moving from romm-sync: point this at its appdata folder (or copy it).

Config.Name: Emulation folder (same path)
Config.Description: ROM folders: ONE folder holding your ROM folders, the frontend links folder and RomM download folders, mounted at the SAME path inside the container (links are absolute). If you change the host path, change the container path to match. Folders are then picked in the page.

Config.Name: ROM source folders
Config.Description: ROM folders: first source folder(s) for the Frontend links grid, ;-separated (e.g. /mnt/user/roms). Can also be set in the page under Source folders.

Config.Name: Frontend links folder
Config.Description: ROM folders: where the folders of links are made, one per frontend (e.g. /mnt/user/emulation/mapping). A folder of its own, not inside a ROM folder.

Config.Name: RomM download folders
Config.Description: ROM folders: the folder(s) RomM reads ROMs from, ;-separated, until set on the RomM library page.

Config.Name: Save sync
Config.Description: auto = on when a RomM address or sync folder is set. false = only ROM folders.

Config.Name: ROM folders
Config.Description: false = only save sync (hides Frontend links and RomM library).

Config.Name: RomM URL
Config.Description: Save sync: address of your RomM instance

Config.Name: RomM auth type
Config.Description: api = Client API token (recommended), http = username/password

Config.Name: RomM API token
Config.Description: RomM → profile → Client API Tokens. Needs assets read/write and roms/platforms read.

Config.Name: RomM username
Config.Description: Only for http auth

Config.Name: RomM password
Config.Description: Only for http auth

Config.Name: Sync mode
Config.Description: watch = react to file changes (and poll RomM), periodic = full sync every SYNC_INTERVAL_SECONDS

Config.Name: New local files → RomM
Config.Description: auto = upload right away (you're still asked when something is unclear), confirm = approve every new file

Config.Name: RomM → folder sync
Config.Description: Download saves/states that are new or newer on RomM. auto = right away (you're still asked when something is unclear)

Config.Name: RomM versions to keep
Config.Description: RomM keeps a copy per upload. Keep only this many per file; older ones go to the recycle bin. 0 = keep all

Config.Name: Syncthing address
Config.Description: Optional, e.g. http://YOUR-SERVER:8384. Waits for Syncthing to finish before syncing and shows your devices. Also on the Settings page

Config.Name: Syncthing API key
Config.Description: Syncthing → Actions → Settings → General → API Key

Config.Name: Folder re-scan (hours)
Config.Description: Watch mode: re-read the sync folders anyway this often in case a change was missed. 0 = only at startup / Sync now

Config.Name: RomM poll interval (s)
Config.Description: Watch mode: how often to check RomM for changes made elsewhere. 0 = only on Sync now

Config.Name: Watch delay (s)
Config.Description: Watch mode: wait for this long without file activity before syncing

Config.Name: Periodic interval (s)
Config.Description: Periodic mode: seconds between full syncs

Config.Name: Full initial sync
Config.Description: Run a full sync when the container starts

Config.Name: Force push
Config.Description: Always overwrite RomM with local files, even on conflicts. Dangerous.

Config.Name: Deletions
Config.Description: A synced file deleted on one side: auto = delete the other copy too (kept in the recycle bin), ask = confirm each, off = never

Config.Name: Recycle bin retention (days)
Config.Description: Recycle bin items are removed for good after this many days. 0 = never

Config.Name: Backup retention (days)
Config.Description: Backups of overwritten files are kept this long. 0 = forever

Config.Name: Dashboard username
Config.Description: Optional basic auth for the whole web page (both parts)

Config.Name: Dashboard password
Config.Description: Optional basic auth for the whole web page (both parts)

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: Owner of files written to the sync folders, and of the frontend links

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group of files written to the sync folders, and of the frontend links

Config.Name: File permissions
Config.Description: Permissions for files and folders written to the sync folders (0777 = read/write for everyone, typical on Unraid)

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Log timestamps and the ROM folders schedule

Config.Name: SAVE_SYNC_FOLDER
Config.Description: Internal: enables the saves mount. Leave as is.

Config.Name: STATE_SYNC_FOLDER
Config.Description: Internal: enables the states mount. Leave as is.
